name: Armboth Forestry Block
blurb: A Lakeland plantation of Sitka spruce in tidy rows, with firebreaks, a clearfell and an osprey-shaped gap in the market.

stages: Dense Sitka in rows, dark underneath.
Rows thinned; native trees along the becks.
Open rides; red squirrel and kite.
Mixed wood with an osprey on the tarn.

ranger: Sitka to the horizon, and not a bird in it. Mind the ditches, they were cut to drain, not to be walked.
I've felled the first rows. Light on the forest floor for the first time in forty years.
Native trees along the becks now. A red squirrel crossed the ride this morning, bold as brass.
Mixed wood and an osprey on the tarn. Whatever they paid for it, it was cheaper than this.
